retry.title: Pairing did not complete
retry.description: Select **Submit** to get a new pairing code and try again.

progress.pair:
Open the local admin panel of the reader and go to the ADARAZ Link (Home Assistant) settings. Enter:

- Server URL: `{url}`
- Pairing code: **{code}**

The code has 12 characters, shown as XXXX-XXXX-XXXX. Letter case and the dashes do not matter. It can be used once and is valid for {minutes} minutes. This page continues by itself when the reader has paired.

error.pairing_expired: The pairing code expired before the reader paired.
error.pairing_failed: The reader sent a wrong pairing code too many times. Check the code and try again.

abort.no_url: Home Assistant has no URL the reader can connect to. Set the local network URL in Settings > System > Network.

not_connected.message: The reader is not connected to Home Assistant

relay_timeout.message: The reader did not answer the relay command in time

relay_not_allowed.message: Remote relay control is disabled on the reader. Enable it in the reader's local admin panel

relay_invalid.message: The reader rejected the relay command as invalid

relay_busy.message: The relay is busy. Try again in a moment
